description.value: A retrospective observational study identified four anatomically distinct behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia subgroups using structural MRI grey matter volumes from regions of interest in the salience and semantic appraisal networks.

spans.text: We examined the prevalence of early clinical symptoms in a large sample of bvFTD patients (n=104), and report the key features of their initial clinical presentation.

value: We hypothesized that patterns of regional vulnerability of brain structures that undergo network-specific degeneration may reveal distinct subtypes within the bvFTD syndrome.

description.value: Retrospective observational study of patients with bvFTD and age-matched healthy imaging controls, evaluated at the UCSF Memory and Aging Center; structural MRI was obtained at the earliest memory-clinic evaluation.

spans.text: In this retrospective observational study, 104 patients meeting the Frontotemporal Dementia Consortium consensus criteria for bvFTD were evaluated at the Memory and Aging Center of Department of Neurology at University of California, San Francisco.

Patients included in the subsequent volumetric analyses (described below), completed their neuropsychological, socioemotional and neurological examinations within 90 days of structural brain imaging (eMethods).
We identified 4 patient clusters based on 18 ROIs defining SN and SAN.
The diagnosis was made at a multidisciplinary consensus meeting for each patient individually.
